findings.problem: The run lookup runs in a servlet filter, outside the MVC exception handler. A RuntimeException from runs.find (DB failure after the session was resolved, or a stored configuration that does not deserialize) escapes the filter chain. The client then gets Spring Boot's default /error body ({timestamp,status,error,path}) instead of 500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"Something went wrong — try again"}, and that body contains the request URL. The spec requires every error body to be exactly {code,message} with no URL. SessionFilter guards its own lookup the same way for this reason.
findings.fix: Wrap the lookup in try/catch (RuntimeException), log it, and write the same 500 INTERNAL_ERROR JSON that SessionFilter writes. Only IllegalArgumentException from UUID.fromString should map to 404.

findings.problem: The spec says PipelineExecutor decides by kind explicitly and that a kind it does not know never falls into the research path. The code uses a two-flag ternary, so any kind that is not ALTERNATIVE or REWRITE takes the STANDARD path (startRunning, research). With the current 3-value RunKind enum this cannot be reached, but adding a kind later would silently run the research path.
findings.fix: Switch exhaustively on queued.kind() (STANDARD -> research, ALTERNATIVE -> reasoning, REWRITE -> story only). Fail any other value as INTERNAL_ERROR.

findings.problem: The language headings rewrite-language-en / -uk are plain divs inside the mat-menu panel (role="menu"). ARIA allows only menuitem, group or separator children in a menu, so screen readers announce the headings as stray content. The 9 items of each language also have no group that names the language.
findings.fix: Wrap each language block in a <div role="group" [attr.aria-label]="languageLabel(lang)">. Give the visible heading role="presentation" or aria-hidden="true". Keep the data-testids and the DOM order.
